trust_decision.summary: The cache identity of a prerendered response is decided by the source route that produced it, not by the request pathname: every non-fetch read/write of the incremental cache must be keyed and ownership-checked by (route kind, source route), so the decision lives in IncrementalCache.get/set plus every call site that must supply the owner.

landing_point.why: The request pathname becomes the storage key here (`_getPathname` -> normalizePagePath) and is handed straight to the cache handler, so anyone reading only the SSG/ISR cache-poisoning summary looks first at this key derivation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A build-time prerender artifact is written to a pathname-derived file path and only read back later by the runtime cache, so a solver can argue that build output is a packaging concern separate from a request-time cache lookup.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The data cache (`fetch` and `use cache`/unstable_cache) is intentionally shared across routes by URL, and `output: 'export'` must keep emitting public path-addressable files; an over-broad fix that scopes every incremental-cache write by route owner, or that rewrites exported public paths, breaks that sharing.

percent-encoded aliases of the same pathname: %2F, %24, %25, %5F, plus Unicode and space parameters

prerender metadata variants: srcRoute null, fallbackSourceRoute set, dataRoute null / .json / .rsc

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second direct cacheHandler consumer keyed by its own pathname-derived key (image, and any future font/OG optimiser)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The image optimiser already bypasses IncrementalCache and calls cacheHandler.get/set directly, so a maintainer adding another optimiser-style cache would copy that shape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another manifest-keyed defaults map (e.g. expire or rendering-mode metadata) looked up by pathname
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The class is a copy-on-write map keyed by route with a prerender-manifest fallback; adding one more per-route default follows the same pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another build-time artifact writer (route handler .body, segment prefetch payloads) that derives its file path from the request pathname
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The build worker already writes HTML/JSON/body/meta next to each other from one pathname-derived path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new response kind (metadata routes such as sitemap.ts / opengraph-image) reusing the same funnel with a pathname key
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Metadata routes are prerendered through the same incremental cache and would naturally be added as one more IncrementalCacheKind.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a `use cache`/data-cache entry that starts carrying route-owner state
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already shares one cache with the response cache through the FETCH kind, so a maintainer extending cache isolation would touch it next.
